maintainerRevisions.description: Flush-face fix by Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Claude Code (2026-11-12). WestFront: west body box made 2 mm shallower in x (west face at x=15.998), so the 2 mm-proud tower faces and the PortalGable stand clear of it (pairs WestFront/PortalGable, WestFront/Tower_N, WestFront/Tower_S); Parapet_*pc / Parapet_*nc (east and west walls of each tower parapet, 4 slabs): each shrunk 4 mm in width, height and length (2 mm per side) so their outer faces, ends and tops no longer share planes with the north and south parapet walls (8 pairs)
